content: In the vector space, the analogy task is transformed into vector arithmetic and search for nearest neighbours, i.e. we compute the distance between vectors: d(vec(Finland), vec(Helsinki)) and search for word $y$ which would give the closest result in distance d(vec(Sweden), vec($y$)). In the analogy dataset the analogies are already pre-specified, so we are measuring how close are the given pairs. In the evaluation below, we use analogy datasets for all tested languages based on the English dataset by BIBREF14 . Due to English-centered bias of this dataset, we used a modified dataset which was first written in Slovene language and then translated into other languages BIBREF15.
